description: Compute and rank routes for a shipment at a departure time, scored for its sensitivity profile: traffic-aware duration and delay, ambient heat or cold along the way against the lane's ceiling, and rain, snow or gusts. Lower score is better and only comparable within one computation. The best route is marked chosen. The response says plainly when routing or weather data was unavailable and the ranking is time-only — relay that; a straight-line estimate is not a traffic-aware route.

depart_at.description: ISO 8601; defaults to the planned departure or now

name: plan_route
